To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSL to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSL ITI Trade Apprentices recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by Cochin Shipyard (CSL) for engaging apprentices at the CSL Mumbai Ship Repair Unit (CMSRU) under the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for ITI Trade Apprentices across various specialized trades including Fitter, Electrician, and Computer Operator & Programming Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 30-09-2026, allowing eligible candidates to register and submit their forms through the official SAP E-recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The final date to successfully submit your online application for the CSL Recruitment 2026 is 19-10-2026. Candidates must complete submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the Xth standard along with a Pass in ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant trade from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to CSL ITI Trade Apprentices posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years of age as on 19-10-2026 to be eligible for applying to these apprenticeship training positions at Cochin Shipyard.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend provided to the selected apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected candidates engaged as ITI Trade Apprentices will receive a consolidated monthly stipend amounting to ₹11,000/- per month during the training period.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to CSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates applying across all categories for the announced ITI Trade Apprentices positions at Cochin Shipyard.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing candidates based on their percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification, followed by certificate verification and a medical fitness test.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official Cochin Shipyard website, completing a one-time registration on the SAP portal, and submitting their applications.
